rules.title: Rent Control Coverage Under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Most multifamily units built before June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and qualifying rooming houses are 'fully covered' and subject to Berkeley rent control. New construction issued a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies starting on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, and certain government-subsidized units are only 'partially covered': they are registered and get just cause and security deposit interest protections but are NOT subject to the rent ceiling. Certain unit types (e.g., owner-occupied 'Golden Duplex', shared owner-occupied units, qualifying ADU tenancies, university housing, nonprofit cooperatives) are fully exempt from rent control.

coverage_conditions.notes: Fully covered: most multifamily built before 1980; single-family homes with tenancies beginning before 1996; qualifying rooming houses (single-family, 5+ rooms individually rented). Partially covered (no rent control): new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancies starting on/after 1996-01-01; most condominiums; units with certain government subsidies (e.g., Section 202/811, project-based Section 8 with HUD-insured mortgage). Fully exempt: 'Golden Duplex' (owner-occupied since 12/31/1979), units with owner-shared kitchen/bath, ADU tenancies begun after 2018-11-07 in owner-occupied properties, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (duplex owner-occupied since 12/31/1979); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.interaction: Partially covered units remain subject to registration, just cause eviction, and security deposit interest requirements even though they are exempt from the rent ceiling.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Coverage Under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protection applies to both fully and partially covered units, including multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes (regardless of tenancy start date), rooming houses, post-1980 new construction, condominiums, and subsidized units. A small set of exempt unit types -- including the owner-occupied 'Golden Duplex,' units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant, certain owner-occupied ADU tenancies begun after November 7, 2018, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives -- receive no just cause protection.

coverage_conditions.notes: Just cause protection extends to all 'fully covered' and 'partially covered' categories (multifamily built before 1980, single-family homes of any tenancy start date, qualifying rooming houses, post-June-1980 new construction, most condos, and specified subsidized units). It does not extend to Golden Duplexes, owner-occupied shared kitchen/bath units, certain owner-occupied ADU tenancies begun after 2018-11-07, university dormitories, or nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied since 12/31/1979); units with owner-shared kitchen/bath where owner lived on property when tenancy started; ADU tenancies begun after Nov 7, 2018 in owner-occupied properties; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.conflict_note: Source is a coverage summary; it lists which units get just cause protection but does not itself enumerate the allowed causes, notice periods, or relocation assistance amounts.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Coverage Under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Tenants in both fully covered and partially covered units (including multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes, rooming houses, post-1980 new construction, condominiums, and subsidized units) are entitled to interest on their security deposits. Tenants in exempt unit types -- Golden Duplexes, owner-occupied shared kitchen/bath units, certain owner-occupied ADU tenancies begun after November 7, 2018, university dormitories, and nonprofit cooperatives -- are not entitled to deposit interest under the ordinance.

coverage_conditions.notes: Security deposit interest applies to all 'fully covered' and 'partially covered' unit categories; it does not apply to Golden Duplexes, owner-occupied shared kitchen/bath units, certain owner-occupied ADU tenancies begun after 2018-11-07, university dormitories, or nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied since 12/31/1979); units with owner-shared kitchen/bath where owner lived on property when tenancy started; ADU tenancies begun after Nov 7, 2018 in owner-occupied properties; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
